'''Star Tours Flight 1007''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Just before the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had arrived at the spaceport's Gate 1K at 0650 hours and was boarding passengers for its scheduled departure time of 0745.
